releaseNotes: v1.8.17: Support Claude OAuth subscription connections end-to-end (PR #13 by @rezhajulio), rename free-tier tool quartet for Antigravity (PR #12 by @yxxrn), add CommandCode CLI User-Agent & schema wrapping (PR #14, fixes #9 reported by @jhonoryza), and support DefaultAPIKey fallback + string input on /v1/responses (PR #15, fixes #10 reported by @pankaj-raikar).
